connections.connectionIntro: Connect a phone or tablet on the same network.
connections.scanApproveShort: Scan the QR code, then approve access on this computer.
connections.permissionApprovedRetry: Permission approved. Try your action again.

connections.scanApprove: Scan the QR, then approve your device here
connections.originRecovery: If your computer’s address changes, scan a fresh QR and approve again. Browsers cannot transfer saved access between addresses.
connections.permissionRequestHelp: This device requests additional access. Approval changes permissions only; the device must try the action again.
connections.permissionRequested: Permission requested. Waiting for your computer. After approval, try your action again.
connections.connectionExpired: Access expired or was revoked. Request approval on your computer again.
connections.enablePhoneAccess: Allow phones on my local network
connections.phoneQrAlt: QR code to open the deck on your phone
connections.phoneQrFailed: Cannot load phone QR code. Refresh to try again.
connections.phonePairStep: On this computer, open Devices and approve your phone. OBS buttons need the Network permission.
connections.phoneScanStep: Scan the QR or open the address above on your phone.
connections.phoneTokenStep: Enter the pairing token on your phone. The QR contains only the deck address.
connections.phoneTroubleshooting: If the page does not open, allow this TCP port in your computer firewall and check that your Wi-Fi allows devices to communicate. Use a trusted local network.

deck.hints.edit: Q — toggle edit mode (saves changes when leaving)
deck.hints.close: Escape — close a dialog or settings
deck.hints.controls: Right-click or touch and hold — deck controls
deck.viewerHelp: Right-click or hold the deck for controls. F1 shows all shortcuts.
learn.learnHelp: A quick introduction, at your own pace. Replay these lessons whenever you need.
learn.demoHelp: Practice a workflow with sample controls. Your deck and computer stay unchanged.
learn.demoSafe: Demo only · No commands are sent to your computer
learn.demoPrompt: Try a scene, toggle the microphone, or start a practice recording.

keyboard.enableAdvanced: Enable advanced simultaneous chord mode to use multiple primary keys.

actions.help.button: Reference another configured button by its stable ID.

pairing.rememberDeviceHelp: Keeps you signed in on this browser after it closes.

pairing.pairingRequestsHelp: Approve only devices you recognize. Requests expire after two minutes.
pairing.pairGrantHelp: Choose the permissions this device receives.

guides.overview.description: Get to know your deck and its main controls.
guides.overview.steps.deck.help: Tap a button to run its action. Right-click or touch and hold to open deck controls.
guides.overview.steps.deck.title: Your deck
guides.overview.steps.folders.help: Folder buttons open another set of controls. Back returns to the parent view.
guides.overview.steps.folders.title: Move between folders
guides.overview.steps.editing.help: Q opens editing. Button changes go into a draft; Save changes applies that draft to your host.
guides.overview.steps.editing.title: Make it yours
guides.overview.steps.connections.help: Connect Device starts phone pairing. Compare its code and approve access on this computer.
guides.overview.steps.connections.title: Bring another device
guides.overview.steps.replay.help: Open Learn WebDeck from deck controls or Settings to replay any guide. F1 opens shortcut help.
guides.overview.steps.replay.title: Keep exploring
guides.overview.title: Take a guided tour
guides.controls.title: Controls and navigation
guides.controls.steps.menu.help: Open this menu with a right-click or a long press on an empty part of the deck.
guides.controls.steps.navigation.title: Home and Back
guides.controls.steps.navigation.help: Home opens the root folder. Back returns to it without changing your buttons.
guides.controls.steps.shortcuts.help: Q toggles editing on the host. Ctrl+, opens Settings. Alt+Left returns home, and Escape closes a dialog.
guides.controls.steps.access.title: Access and help
guides.controls.steps.access.help: Connected controllers only see actions their permissions allow. Use Request permission when more access is needed. Learn WebDeck reopens these guides.
guides.editing.title: Editing and folders
guides.editing.description: Create, organize and save your deck.
guides.editing.steps.toolbar.title: Editing tools
guides.editing.steps.toolbar.help: The toolbar follows the current folder. These folder examples are temporary and will be discarded after the guide.
guides.editing.steps.add.title: Add or edit a button
guides.editing.steps.add.help: Choose an empty + cell to add a button, or use a tile’s pencil to edit it. Folder tiles still navigate while editing.
guides.editing.steps.folders.title: Organize folders
guides.editing.steps.folders.help: New folder creates a child folder with a Back button. Delete folder is only offered inside a child folder.
guides.editing.steps.rename.title: Rename a folder
guides.editing.steps.rename.help: Use the pencil to rename a child folder. Enter confirms and Escape cancels. The root folder is protected.
guides.editing.steps.save.title: Save the draft
guides.editing.steps.save.help: Applied edits stay in the draft until you save. Save changes appears when there are pending edits; conflicts keep your draft.
guides.editing.steps.done.title: Finish editing
guides.editing.steps.done.help: Done saves pending changes before leaving editing. Closing this guide restores the folder and editing state you started with.
guides.content.title: Button content and images
guides.content.description: Labels, icons, file drops and image imports.
guides.content.steps.label.title: Name the button
guides.content.steps.label.help: This disposable example uses the real editor. Set a short label; its folder is already determined by where you opened it.
guides.content.steps.preview.title: See the result
guides.content.steps.preview.help: The preview updates as you change the label, visual and appearance.
guides.content.steps.icon.title: Choose an icon
guides.content.steps.icon.help: Use the icon library for a built-in symbol. Icon and Image are two ways to define the same button visual.
guides.content.steps.file.title: Use an image
guides.content.steps.file.help: Drop one supported image or choose a file. The same file card shows its name and lets you replace it.
guides.content.steps.imports.title: Import from URL or host
guides.content.steps.imports.help: Import URL fetches an image. Local file imports from the host. Keep a URL only when you want to refresh that image later.
guides.content.steps.library.title: Reuse uploaded images
guides.content.steps.library.help: Imported images appear in the library. The example here is local to this lesson; no file is uploaded.
guides.content.steps.apply.title: Apply, then save
guides.content.steps.apply.help: Apply to draft stages one button; Save changes persists the whole deck. Example edits in this guide are discarded.
guides.buttonAppearance.title: Button appearance
guides.buttonAppearance.description: Color, size, icon scale and labels.
guides.buttonAppearance.steps.color.help: Choose the button color with the swatch or enter a hex value. Try it here on the temporary example.
guides.buttonAppearance.steps.span.title: Button dimensions
guides.buttonAppearance.steps.span.help: Column and row spans let a button occupy more cells. The deck keeps its position when possible.
guides.buttonAppearance.steps.scale.help: Scale the icon to suit the button. The compact preview shows the selected visual.
guides.buttonAppearance.steps.label.help: Keep labels visible for readability, or hide a label when the visual is sufficient.
guides.buttonAppearance.steps.apply.help: Apply to draft stages this button. Cancel leaves the previous draft untouched. This lesson never applies its example.
guides.actions.title: Actions and automation
guides.actions.description: Find actions, configure arguments and build workflows.
guides.actions.steps.current.title: Choose what the button does
guides.actions.steps.current.help: Every button has an action. Change action opens the catalogue without discarding the current configuration until you select a replacement.
guides.actions.steps.filter.title: Find an action
guides.actions.steps.filter.help: Search by name or filter by category. Try the search on this disposable example.
guides.actions.steps.catalog.title: Review available actions
guides.actions.steps.catalog.help: Select an action and confirm, or cancel to keep the existing one. Some actions need host permissions or an integration.
guides.actions.steps.arguments.title: Configure the action
guides.actions.steps.arguments.help: Fields depend on the selected action. Enter a file, URL, text, keys or other required arguments before applying.
guides.actions.steps.workflow.title: Build a workflow
guides.actions.steps.workflow.help: Workflows combine commands, sequences, parallel branches and delays. Configure each step before saving.
guides.actions.steps.plugins.title: Use plugins and scripts
guides.actions.steps.plugins.help: Installed plugins expose their own arguments. Runtime shows their status. Script and workflow actions retain the permissions granted to the caller.
guides.keyboard.description: Record a shortcut or choose keys manually.
guides.keyboard.steps.preview.title: Your shortcut
guides.keyboard.steps.preview.help: This example is temporary. It shows the keys together without sending them to your computer.
guides.keyboard.steps.record.title: Record a combination
guides.keyboard.steps.record.help: Choose Record shortcut, then press the combination. Escape cancels recording. You can try recording in this example.
guides.keyboard.steps.modifiers.title: Set modifiers
guides.keyboard.steps.modifiers.help: Ctrl, Shift, Alt and Meta are independent toggles. Try them on the example selection.
guides.keyboard.steps.search.title: Search and filter keys
guides.keyboard.steps.search.help: Search finds keys across categories. The category selector narrows the results without changing your shortcut.
guides.keyboard.steps.keys.title: Choose the main key
guides.keyboard.steps.keys.help: Pick one main key; use arrow keys to move through the grid. Unavailable keys are disabled.
guides.keyboard.steps.advanced.title: More than one main key
guides.keyboard.steps.advanced.help: Enable Multiple keys for keys pressed simultaneously. Use shortcut confirms this selection inside the editor.
guides.keyboard.steps.apply.title: Apply the shortcut
guides.keyboard.steps.apply.help: Apply to draft stages the button, then Save changes persists it. This guide discards its example instead.
guides.audio.title: Audio fragments
guides.audio.description: Load sound, trim a fragment and choose playback settings.
guides.audio.steps.source.title: Choose audio
guides.audio.steps.source.help: Choose or drop MP3, WAV, OGG or FLAC audio. This guide uses a generated local sample and uploads nothing.
guides.audio.steps.wave.title: Select a fragment
guides.audio.steps.wave.help: Drag the handles or use their arrow keys to set the bounds. Hover shows the time at the pointer. Try the local example.
guides.audio.steps.times.title: Fine-tune the bounds
guides.audio.steps.times.help: Start and end must stay inside the file. Duration is calculated automatically. Reset restores the whole clip.
guides.audio.steps.preview.title: Listen to the fragment
guides.audio.steps.preview.help: Preview plays the selected local sample in this browser. It does not execute a host sound action.
guides.audio.steps.volume.title: Set the volume
guides.audio.steps.volume.help: The slider and percentage stay synchronized from 0 to 100. Try either control on the sample.
guides.audio.steps.output.title: Choose the output
guides.audio.steps.output.help: The button uses the host output selected here, or its system default. Check that the device is still connected.
guides.audio.steps.apply.title: Keep the original audio
guides.audio.steps.apply.help: The button stores playback bounds without rewriting the file. Apply to draft and Save changes commit them outside this lesson.
guides.appearance.title: Layout, language and themes
guides.appearance.description: Customize the grid and its visual settings.
guides.appearance.steps.layout.title: Grid dimensions
guides.appearance.steps.layout.help: Columns and rows determine the available cells. Existing buttons retain their saved positions when the layout changes.
guides.appearance.steps.style.title: Shared button style
guides.appearance.steps.style.help: Set tile height, spacing, corners and icon size. Individual buttons can have their own appearance.
guides.appearance.steps.preview.title: Check the preview
guides.appearance.steps.preview.help: The preview uses the current draft. Your real settings remain untouched during this walkthrough.
guides.appearance.steps.language.title: Choose a language
guides.appearance.steps.language.help: Choose the interface language. Save changes applies the selection across the app.
guides.appearance.steps.files.title: Backgrounds and themes
guides.appearance.steps.files.help: Upload a background image or CSS theme. Remove detaches it from the draft; it does not erase your other controls.
guides.appearance.steps.save.title: Save settings
guides.appearance.steps.save.help: Changes stay in the same deck draft. Save when ready; Back to deck preserves pending edits.
guides.integrations.title: OBS and Spotify
guides.integrations.steps.obs.title: Configure OBS
guides.integrations.steps.obs.help: Enable OBS WebSocket on the host and enter its address and port here.
guides.integrations.steps.password.title: Keep credentials private
guides.integrations.steps.password.help: OBS passwords stay hidden. Reveal them only when you need to check the value.
guides.integrations.steps.check.title: Save and check OBS
guides.integrations.steps.check.help: This button saves the draft before checking OBS. A successful status check does not start recording or streaming.
guides.integrations.steps.spotify.title: Configure Spotify
guides.integrations.steps.spotify.help: Enter the client ID, secret and redirect URI for your Spotify application. The secret is hidden by default.
guides.integrations.steps.authorize.help: Connect Spotify saves first and prepares an authorization link. Continue there to authorize this host.
guides.integrations.steps.status.title: Understand connection status
guides.integrations.steps.status.help: Stored authorization and live playback verification are different states. Configure a Spotify action after authorizing.
guides.connections.title: Connect and manage devices
guides.connections.description: Pair a phone, review access and manage trust.
guides.connections.steps.start.title: Start a connection
guides.connections.steps.start.help: Connect Device enables the listener and creates a short-lived invitation when you choose it outside this guide.
guides.connections.steps.qr.title: Scan the invitation
guides.connections.steps.qr.help: This is a preview of the invitation screen. A real QR and link appear after starting a connection; scan them on your phone.
guides.connections.steps.code.title: Compare the code
guides.connections.steps.code.help: On the computer, compare the code with your phone before approving it. This approval request is an example.
guides.connections.steps.profile.title: Grant the access it needs
guides.connections.steps.profile.help: View only shows the deck. Deck actions grants the permissions its buttons need. Custom lets you choose individual capabilities.
guides.connections.steps.expiry.title: Choose an expiry
guides.connections.steps.expiry.help: Use temporary access for a short session, or trust a personal device for longer. Approval never runs an action automatically.
guides.connections.steps.manage.title: Manage trusted devices
guides.connections.steps.manage.help: Review status and expiry here. Renew a device’s access, change its profile or revoke it when it is no longer needed.
guides.network.title: Network and connection recovery
guides.network.steps.access.title: Phone access
guides.network.steps.access.help: Phone access controls the LAN listener. These settings apply separately from the deck draft.
guides.network.steps.address.title: Address and port
guides.network.steps.address.help: Use the detected LAN address or enter an override. Your phone needs the reachable host address, not 127.0.0.1.
guides.network.steps.apply.title: Apply network changes
guides.network.steps.apply.help: Apply phone access changes the listener immediately. Review the address and firewall before sharing its link.
guides.network.steps.transport.title: Choose the transport
guides.network.steps.transport.help: HTTP and Realtime send the same actions. Realtime status describes the current browser connection.
guides.network.steps.diagnostics.title: Recover a connection
guides.network.steps.diagnostics.help: Check address, port and firewall in diagnostics. After an origin change, reopen the new URL and pair again if needed.
guides.network.steps.token.title: Manual pairing
guides.network.steps.token.help: Use a manual token only when invitation pairing is unavailable. Copy it once, share it only with the intended device, and hide it afterward.
guides.backups.title: Backups and recovery
guides.backups.description: Inspect a backup, stage a restore and recover from conflicts.
guides.backups.steps.inspect.title: Inspect a backup
guides.backups.steps.inspect.help: Choose a canonical v2 JSON backup. Inspection validates it and shows a preview before changing your draft.
guides.backups.steps.preview.title: Review the contents
guides.backups.steps.preview.help: This example preview uses your current draft counts. Apply backup to draft replaces the draft only after you confirm pending changes.
guides.backups.steps.save.title: Save the restored draft
guides.backups.steps.save.help: Restoring prepares a draft. Save changes applies it to the host; closing this lesson does not restore a backup.
guides.backups.steps.export.title: Export before recovery
guides.backups.steps.export.help: Download backup exports the current draft, including unsaved edits. Keep a copy before replacing or reloading it.
guides.backups.steps.reload.title: Handle a save conflict
guides.backups.steps.reload.help: A revision conflict keeps your draft. Export it, then reload the host configuration when you are ready to compare and reapply changes.
guides.runtime.title: Runtime and plugins
guides.runtime.description: Inspect runtime health and installed extensions.
guides.runtime.steps.health.title: Inspect runtime status
guides.runtime.steps.health.help: Runtime reports whether its command engine is healthy and how many commands it exposes.
guides.runtime.steps.plugins.title: Review installed plugins
guides.runtime.steps.plugins.help: Installed plugins show their version and backend. Enable or disable an external plugin deliberately; built-in plugins remain protected.
guides.runtime.steps.reload.title: Reload after installation
guides.runtime.steps.reload.help: Reload plugins refreshes the runtime and the app configuration. Finish or export your draft before using it.
guides.pairing.title: Pair this controller
guides.pairing.description: Request host approval and restore remembered access.
guides.pairing.steps.intro.title: Connect to your computer
guides.pairing.steps.intro.help: Open the invitation on this device. Your computer decides which permissions to grant.
guides.pairing.steps.remember.title: Remember this device
guides.pairing.steps.remember.help: Remembered access reconnects this browser after reloads. Leave it off on a shared device.
guides.pairing.steps.name.title: Name the device
guides.pairing.steps.name.help: Choose a name you can recognize on the host approval screen.
guides.pairing.steps.request.title: Request access
guides.pairing.steps.request.help: Request access sends the name to the computer. Scanned invitations can start that request automatically.
guides.pairing.steps.code.title: Compare and wait
guides.pairing.steps.code.help: This is an example code. Compare the real code on both screens and wait for host approval; expired or rejected requests can be retried.
guides.pairing.steps.token.title: Use an existing token
guides.pairing.steps.token.help: Manual tokens are an alternative when the host provides one. Keep the token private and request a new grant after revocation.
guides.practice.title: Guided practice
guides.practice.description: Try local scene, microphone and recording controls.
guides.practice.steps.intro.title: Practice safely
guides.practice.steps.intro.help: These controls only change this demo. They do not connect to OBS, use your microphone or run host commands.
guides.practice.steps.scene.title: Choose a scene
guides.practice.steps.scene.help: Try the Break scene button and watch the feedback.
guides.practice.steps.microphone.title: Toggle the microphone
guides.practice.steps.microphone.help: Toggle the demo microphone. The status changes locally; no audio is captured.
guides.practice.steps.recording.title: Try recording controls
guides.practice.steps.recording.help: Toggle the demo recording state. No recording is created.
guides.practice.steps.reset.title: Start again
guides.practice.steps.reset.help: Reset returns this demo to its initial state. Replay the guide or return to the learning library whenever you need.
guides.library.targetMissing: This screen is no longer available. Open the guide again to retry.
guides.library.invitationPlaceholder: Your QR appears here after you start a connection.
guides.library.readonly: Finish the guide before saving or running host actions.
errors.invalidJson: Enter valid JSON, for example true, 42, "text", or {"key": "value"}.
errors.commandTimeout: Request timed out; execution outcome is unknown. No retry was sent.
errors.invalidDimensions: Grid dimensions must be integers from 1 to 128.
errors.lastFolder: The deck needs at least one folder
errors.editForbidden: This device has no deck editing permission.
errors.actionUnavailable: This action is unavailable. Reload the deck.
errors.refreshAfterSave: Saved. Display refresh failed; reload when ready.
errors.saveInProgress: Wait for saving to finish before reloading.
forms.select.required: Choose an option or enter a target.
forms.map.duplicateKey: Use a unique name for each row.
forms.http.invalidHeader: Enter a valid header name and a single-line value.
forms.source.title: Source
forms.source.chooseLocal: Choose a file on this computer
forms.apps.label: Application
forms.apps.placeholder: Choose an application or enter a target
forms.apps.unavailable: Applications could not be listed. You can enter the target manually.
